name: CMOS static set-reset latch
description: Two cross-coupled CMOS NOR gates store a set/reset state; two inverters buffer Q into a 500 fF output. Twelve MOS devices and three capacitors are explicit. Active-high s sets Q and r resets Q; both low retain the state. Six transient checks cover initial reset, setting, retaining both states, resetting and setting again. Simultaneous s=r=1 is invalid and excluded from the experiment. Educational nominal models; no arbitration, metastability or PVT guarantee.
